metadata.title: Set-ExportServerConfigurationProfileLocalREDFISH
metadata.description: iDRAC cmdlet used to export server configuration profile locally using Redfish API. It will display the attributes locally to the screen along with copying them to a file. For more details on SCP feature, refer to document "https://downloads.dell.com/Manuals/Common/dellemc-server-config-profile-refguide.pdf"

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Set-ExportServerConfigurationProfileLocalREDFISH' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00002.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$idrac_password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
